candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record documents both the biopsy-confirmed ALK-positive lung adenocarcinoma and a distinct rheumatologic syndrome (seronegative symmetrical synovitis with bilateral pitting edema, i.e., RS3PE) that is paraneoplastic in nature. C001 names only the oncologic component and does not address the RS3PE manifestation, leaving the composite diagnosis incomplete.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Captures the primary malignancy (ALK-positive lung adenocarcinoma) but omits the paraneoplastic RS3PE syndrome component, which is an explicitly required part of the composite benchmark diagnosis

case_quality_flags: Composite diagnosis required: primary malignancy plus paraneoplastic syndrome; candidates addressing only one component should be rated partial
